Description:
With a resounding impact, the greatsword cleaves through the air, connecting with the beast's tail in a mighty blow. The wyvern wheels around, its massive jaws primed to ensnare the warrior in their deadly embrace. In a daring maneuver, the fighter relinquishes her blade, seizing the wyvern's jaw in a vice-like grip, diverting its momentum towards a nearby tree. She ascends onto the creature's head, plunging her blade deep into its eye with lethal precision. It is then that you observe a miraculous sight: her previously bloody wounds have miraculously sealed, as if cauterized by the scorching heat of battle and the coursing adrenaline of combat.
Warriors are talented in using any type of weapon, with hand-to-hand combat capabilities way beyond the average adventurer. Brawn and tactics are a warrior's aces in the sleeve.
A warrior is a physical combatant, but that does not stop them from overcoming challenges. With mastery over arms, body or range, a warrior may improvise and lead their way to victory.
Quick Note: A warrior is a physical combatant, but that does not stop them from overcoming challenges. With mastery over arms, body or range, a warrior may improvise and lead their way to victory.
Weapons: You are Trained in all weapons, including Shields.

Spellcasting.Spell Grade: 6 + Intelligence, Sense or Sense, whichever is higher

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Warrior-specific Abilities are not considered Spells (unless stated otherwise).

~Path of the Berserker~.Effect:
Instead of having normal Health Regen, 200% of your Health Regen is added to your Max Health (and as such your Health Regen after combat is always 0).
You can not gain extra Defense except through magical means (magic items, spells, etc).
~Path of the Berserker~.Notes: Increasing Health Regen increases your Max Health instead (and losing Health Regen loses you Max Health instead).

~Onslaught~.Effect: Whenever ^YOU^ kill a Worthy Enemy, heal for 1d6 Health. In addition, if an Enemy has 25% or less Health, you know exactly how much Health it has (ask the QM).

~Reckless Charge~.Effect:
Freely dash exactly 2 meters towards a Worthy Enemy, landing on the closest space. It becomes Rooted.
~Your next weapon attack deals 2d6 extra Damage to the target and half of that to yourself.~
You can only use this once on every Worthy Enemy.

~Charge~.Effect: Freely dash exactly 2 meters toward a Worthy Enemy, landing on the closest space, near them.

~War Craft~.Effect:
No two warriors fight alike. Choose your War Craft from below!
Each War Craft usually gives you a way to deal {Color('#ff5900' '+1d4 extra Damage each Turn')}.
~War Craft~.Upgrade: You may change your War Craft inbetween Adventures.

Other Abilities Description: Choose one of the following War Crafts that will change your playstyle! These are not the same as the Level 1 Talents (which are below), and you still get one free War Craft and one free Level 1 Talent.

~Shield Craft~.Effect: Use after you are melee attacked. Deal 1d4 Smash Damage with your {Color('#ff5900' 'shield')} to the attacker.

~Dualwield Craft~.Effect: Your {Color('#ff5900' 'second one-handed')} attack with a real weapon each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if it is with a different weapon than the first attack')}.

~Heavy Weapon Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'two-handed')} weapon attack each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if there is an Ally, obstacle or wall directly behind the target')}.

~Throw Craft~.Effect:
You may throw real melee weapons with a 3-5 meter range. They deal -1 Damage for one-handed weapons (or -2 Damage for two-handed weapons).
Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'thrown')} weapon attack each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if it's the first Act you do on your Turn and you have a clear throw to the target')}.

~Unarmed Craft~.Effect: Your {Color('#ff5900' 'second Punch')} attack each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' "if it's on a different target than the first")}.

~Marksman Craft~.Effect:
Your first ~ranged~ weapon attack each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if there is no Unit or obstacle near the target')}.
Your Charge becomes Uncharge.

~Uncharge~.Effect: Freely dash exactly 2 meters toward an ~Ally~, landing on the closest space, near them.
~Uncharge~.Combo: If the Ally had a Combo, make a free Move Act.

~Dual Shield Craft~.Effect:
You can Dual Wield shields and attack with them for 1d6 + ^Any Stat^ Damage.
After you Charge, gain 1d4 Shielding.

~Improvisation Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'Improvised Attack')} each Turn deals +1d6 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if it's with an improvised weapon type you haven't used this Adventure')}.

~Old-Fashioned Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'old-fashioned')} weapon attack each Turn deals extra Damage equal to ^Any Stat^, {Color('#ff5900' 'and applies a ~Combo~ if the target is a Person')}.
~Old-Fashioned Craft~.Upgrade: Old-fashioned weapons are weapons that do not deal extra Damage with any Stat (e.g. Hammer).

~Vault Break~.Effect:
Slam the ground so hard that it shatters one obstacle that fits within a 3x3x3 meter area.
After casting this Ability, if you moved this turn, you can continue your movement.
~Vault Break~.Notes: It is the Quest Master's call if an obstacle can be broken. Most walls can't be broken, except for thinner ones and fences.

~Sound Mind~.Effect: Block any non-damaging negative incoming _effect_ on an ally you can see.
~Sound Mind~.Upgrade: Negative effects in this case means any Crowd Control, Debuff, Curse, mind-altering magic, non-Damaging Poison, etc.

~Doublesault~.Effect: Leap up to 3 meters. If you land on a Unit, Doublesault again (for free)!
~Doublesault~.Notes:
You leap from Unit to Unit until you no longer land on a Unit. If you land on a Unit, you must leap again. You can't leap on the same Unit twice; if you do, you end your leap in the closest space near it.
You can use this even while in the air and it cancels out your current fall or acceleration.

~Snap Out Of It~.Effect: Attack a different Unit with a 1-handed weapon. It heals instead of dealing Damage.
~Snap Out Of It~.Notes: Any extra Damage effects on it heal as well (e.g. Smite, Cursewielder, etc).

~Strength and Honor~.Effect:
You may exceed the Level limits for maximum Stats.
You start with +1 in any Stat.
~Strength and Honor~.Notes: The maximum a Stat can be until Level 4 is +3. Between 4 and 8 is +4. There is no limit from Level 8 on.

~Bristleback~.Effect: You take less Damage when struck from behind. Enemies with 2 or less Sense...

~Hemmingstep~.Effect: When standing right next to a wall, you take -1 Damage from all sources.

~Painfeast~.Effect: Until the start of your next Turn, all Damage you take is transformed into Healing instead!

~Heavenbreaker~.Effect:
You jump high up above the battlefield and end your Turn.
At the start of your next Turn, you plunge into the earth like a comet toward a destintion space.
All Units within 3 meters of you take X Damage TODO and a crater forms in the zone, 2 meters deep at the extremities of the area.

~Survive Killing Blow~.Effect: Damage puts you at negative Health. When the effect expires, heal for that amount.

~Bloodlusting More~.Effect: If an enemy dies around you, heal.

~Strength of Giants~.Effect: You can't be damaged for more than 10% of your Maximum Health at once.

~Wolf Apparition~.Effect: Summon something with health equal to your missing health

<Undying Rage>.Effect:
Taking Damage that would kill you puts you in a state of primal rage, and leaves you at 1 Health instead.
For the rest of the Combat, increase all Healing you do on yourself by 50%.

<Blood and Fire>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Strike a Unit for an amount of Fire Damage equal to 50% of your missing Health.

<Primal Trophy>.Effect:
Whenever ^YOU^ kill a Worthy Enemy, gain one Primal Trophy. Every 3 Primal Trophies increase your Max Health by 1.
Every 10 Primal Trophies give you an extra non-combat Skill (make you Skilled in a type of activity).

~Bloodlust~.Effect: Add 1d4 Damage to a weapon attack for each 10 Health you are missing.
~Bloodlust~.Notes: This is not considered a Spell.

<Heartbeat Trance>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Then, until the ^end^ of your next Turn, you take 50% less Damage (including from your own Abilities).
When Heartbeat Trance ends, heal for 1d6.

<Rage Trance>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Until the ^end^ of your next Turn, all your attacks deal +1d4 Damage and Onslaught healing is increased by 100%.
When Rage Trance ends, heal for 1d6.

<Battle Trance>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Until the ^end^ of your next Turn, all Damage you do to yourself becomes Healing instead and you are immune to Crowd Control.
When Battle Trance ends, heal for 2d6.

<Hunger For Blood>.Effect: Whenever you deal Damage to a Worthy Enemy, heal for 10% of it (rounded down).

<Last Resort>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Your next single-target weapon attack deals +1d20 Damage.
For the rest of the Combat, you deal -50% Damage but increase all Healing you do by 50%.

~FURY~.Upgrade: Every time you do Healing or weapon Damage, do +1 for each {Orange('Fury')}, then lose 1 {Orange('Fury')}.

~Painful Puncture~.Effect: Attack a Unit for 1d6 + 2 Damage of your ^weapon^'s type. Its Passives, weapon* effects and Reactions are disabled until the start of your next Turn.
~Painful Puncture~.Notes: Its Passives become disabled before you hit it (e.g. Kobolds don't dodge this attack). Some monsters have special weapon* effects, like Centaurs who gain extra Damage based on how much they moved. These are disabled.

<Blood Craft>.Effect: Whenever you Damage with War Craft to a Worthy Enemy, Damage yourself equal to the original roll, then increase it by 100% to the enemy.

<Death Mark>.Effect:
Mark a Unit you can see for death.
Whenever YOU deal Damage to it until your next turn, remember the Damage done.
At the start of your next turn, the mark bursts and the Unit takes 50% of the Damage it has taken in this time period.

<Earthshattering Wave>.Effect:
All units in a line must succeed a Might Check against _10% of your Max Health_ or be Triple-Stunned. If they succeed, they become Fumbling instead.
The line is 3 meters wide, and has a length of 1 meter for ever 5 Health you are missing.
<Earthshattering Wave>.Notes:
E.g. if you have 30 out of 50 Health (thus missing 20 Health), then the line will be 4 meters long.
Cover is applied normally.

<Ruining Shout>.Effect:
Damages all Enemies within 4 meters of you.
Deals 1d6 Psychic Damage for each 1 meter to the target (up to 4d6).
Roll 4d6 at the same time, and choose which dice affect the units closer.

<Tribal Tattoos>.Effect:
Your Max Health is further increased by 8.
Every Adventure, you add another tattoo and increase it by 1.
Every 3 new tattoos, gain +1 in any Resist Check of choice.

<One With My Body>.Effect: Choose any Druid or Hunter Utility Talent from any Level.

<Victory Strike>.Effect:
Attack a Unit for 2d10 Damage of your weapon's type.
Whenever ^YOU^ kill a Worthy Enemy (with anything), reset the Cooldown of this Ability.

<Frenzy>.Effect:
If you start your turn with 25 or less Health, you have +1 Movement Speed and can Break your Movement.
if you start with 15 or less Health, you also have an extra 1 Action Point.

<Hurl Over>.Effect:
Grab another non-Epic Unit and throw them up to 10 meters away.
Upon landing, all other Units within 3 meters of the landing place take 3d8 Pulse Damage.
If it was an Enemy, the Thrown Unit takes 50% of the Damage.

<Jotunn>.Effect:
You grow to the size of a giant and become Large.
You gain Shielding equal to 50% of your missing Health.
Your normal Melee attacks hit all Units within 1 meter of the target for the same Damage, without the Stat modifier (e.g. you don't add + Might or Dexterity to the secondary targets).
You are immune to being Crowd Control and Hard Terrain.

<Echoes of Fury>.Effect: Your _echoes_ can hit the same target (with -50% Damage/Healing). However, if it hits a different target, the Damage or Healing is no longer reduced by 50%.

<Forced Echoes>.Effect: Your Shaman Abilities and Talents ALWAYS _echo_.
<Forced Echoes>.Notes:
When Bloodlust _echoes_, the baseline attack (with the Bloodlust Damage included) echoes as well.
When Ruining Shout _echoes_, it can hit all the same targets.

<Bloodbath>.Effect: You heal for all Damage done by Advanced Flank on Worthy Enemies.

<Echoing Self>.Effect: A spectral self appears at the position where you started your turn, and repeats all Acts you have already done this turn.
<Echoing Self>.Notes:
An Act is considered any Movement, attack or Ability that took at least 0 Action Points (does not include Passives that triggered and _echoes_ that had already happened this turn).
The clone moves exactly as you did (can go through Units) and repeats the Spells and Attacks on the same targets. If there were any dice rolls, the clone rolls them (don't use the same numbers rolled). The clone is a separate special Unit - self effects apply to the clone (and thus self-heals have no effect).

<Flesh of Iron>.Effect:
You Heal for all Damage you would deal to yourself instead of taking it. Pierce, Slash and Smash attacks can't Damage you below 1 Health (they leave you to 1 Health).
Also, passively, you gain +2 Might.
<Flesh of Iron>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.

<Ferocity Unleashed>.Effect:
If you start your turn with 50% or less Health, you have an extra 2 Action Points on your turn.
Also, passively, gain +1 Might, Dexterity and Sense, you are immune to exhaustion in Worthy Combat and you can survive without sleep for 7 days.
<Ferocity Unleashed>.Notes: This stacks with the Frenzy Talent.
<Ferocity Unleashed>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.

<MIGHT BRAWN MUSCLE>.Effect: GAIN +10 MIGHT AND THE RESULTS OF ALL YOUR MIGHT CHECKS ARE DOUBLED.
<MIGHT BRAWN MUSCLE>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
